title: HackerRank's AI interviewer offers a glimpse into what job interviews could become | TechCrunch
summary: Ravisankar told TechCrunch that Chakra is changing the basic structure of the hiring process itself. Ravisankar told TechCrunch that Chakra is designed to score candidates rather than make the final hiring decision, which remains with humans.
